name: High School Story
source:
Welcome to high school! Will you study hard, or hardly study? Don't get too busy... Homecoming is right around the corner!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/High_School_Story,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
